scripts.gen:bruno:
bru import openapi --source ../api/openapi.yaml --output src/bruno --collection-name "TourneyHub API" && mkdir -p src/bruno/environments && echo 'name: local
variables:
  - name: baseUrl
    value: http://localhost:8080/api/v1
  - name: token
    value: ""' > src/bruno/environments/local.yml
scripts.gen:bruno:check:
bru import openapi --source ../api/openapi.yaml --output /tmp/bruno-check --collection-name "TourneyHub API" && echo 'name: local
variables:
  - name: baseUrl
    value: http://localhost:8080/api/v1
  - name: token
    value: ""' > /tmp/bruno-check/environments/local.yml && diff -rq /tmp/bruno-check src/bruno
